name: Coca-Cola

news.headline: Coca-Cola's 64th straight raise, priced at a premium
news.summary: Margins widened in Q3, guidance was raised for a third consecutive report and the raise run hit 64 years, but the piece is blunt that a 40% run has left the shares expensive against the index — an income holding, not a re-rating at this price.

flags: KO goes ex-dividend on 1 December 2026 with a $2.12 annual payout (2.18% at today's close) — the next cash event on this line, from the quote page rather than the news.
